courseOutcomes.description: Articulate the fundamental concepts of cloud computing, its types, and how cloud computing architecture operates.
Understand and describe the foundations of virtualization, its relationship with cloud computing.
Describe various cloud computing services, understand the different service models, and identify potential risks.
Demonstrate proficiency in using cloud computing tools such as Apache Hadoop, and deploy applications using popular cloud platforms.
